header: Each location, its address and its contact
lead: The card is headed by the place, because a reader on this band is looking for a location first and a name second. The child's role holds the office name and its text holds the address; the person's own name stays the record title, so the backend list is still scannable.

contacts.title: The contact's name
contacts.text:
The address is a real address element
Set upright rather than italic
and it keeps the line breaks it was typed with

contacts.title: Linked when there is a link
contacts.text:
The contact row is pushed to the foot of the card
so a four-line address still ends level with a two-line one
